articles.title: Battlefield 6 Is Adding Something Fans Have Wanted Since Day 1
articles.summary: EA and Battlefield Studios have unveiled more details on Battlefield 6 's upcoming Season 5, and it includes a new feature that fans have wanted since day one: a proper server browser.
body: Battlefield did indeed launch with a server browser, but--considering how it only supported Portal mode--it wasn't the one fans wanted. One of the game's producers asked why players even want a full server browser. Now, in response to the feedback, Battlefield Studios is adding a proper server browser with the Season 5 update this December, allowing people to create their own servers and set rules like map rotation and other particulars. Classic-era Battlefield games had server browsers, and fans flocked to them because they could pick and choose exactly the maps and modes they wanted to play.

Season 5 rolls out in waves, beginning with Siege of Las Vegas on October 13, which adds two new maps: Vegas Strip and Area 51. For Battlefield 6's battle royale RedSec, Siege of Las Vegas adds a new version of the mode called Rapid Royale, which promises faster rounds with smaller player populations.
points: EA and Battlefield Studios have unveiled more details on Battlefield 6 's upcoming Season 5, and it includes a new feature that fans have wanted since day one: a proper server browser.

articles.title: Dungeons & Dragons Is Going to Outer Space With Star Wars: Tyro Squadron, First Look at Official Art
articles.summary: Dungeons & Dragons: World of Warcraft isn't even out yet, but Wizards of the Coast has already announced its next Universes Beyond release for the TTRPG – and it's Star Wars.
body: WotC announced that something Star Wars was coming to D&D back at Gen Con in July, but at NYCC 2026, it confirmed a new adventure, Star Wars: Tyro Squadron, along with a new Core Rules expansion for the Galaxy Far, Far Away.

The new Core Rules will likely be as large in scope as the recent World of Warcraft expansion, with a ton of story hooks and new ways to play classic D&D classes, but we don't know anything specific. WotC did reveal some information about the Tyro Squadron adventure module, however, but even then, there's not much there.

According to Wizards of the Coast, Tyro Squadron will let players "take the fight to the Empire as part of a secret Rebel crew. Set during the Original Trilogy, these new stories unfold as Luke and Leia fight their own battles across the galaxy. Fly daring missions, explore new corners of the galaxy, and help shape the Rebellion’s story."

Just like with Star Wars: Zero Company earlier this year, this new D&D campaign sounds like it focuses on the seedy underbelly of the Star Wars universe, rather than the bombastic heroics of Luke & Co.

articles.title: Street Fighter Was On Death’s Door, And Its Players Weren’t Getting Any Younger
articles.summary: Street Fighter 5 launched in 2016 in rough shape, and if things hadn't changed, the classic fighting game franchise might have been dead and buried by 2026. That's according to Street Fighter 6 producer Shuhei Matsumoto and game director Takayuki Nakayama, who recently spoke about how Capcom's…
body: Matsumoto added that while Street Fighter was still recognizable as a franchise, that didn't mean people were engaging with it. If things didn't change, Matsumoto predicted that the IP "would likely die in 10 years."

The turning point came with Street Fighter 6, as the team approached its development as if it were a brand-new fighting game. By not relying on the legacy of Street Fighter, designing the Modern Control scheme to level the playing field, adding World Tour mode, and incorporating the fighting game community more closely into the project, Street Fighter 6 proved to be a hit when it was released in 2023.

Street Fighter 6 is also arguably the fighting game of the current decade. It still has a healthy audience, has expanded with post-launch content, and its modernized control schemes have attracted new players. It would have been a strange twist of fate if Street Fighter did fade into obscurity, as back in the late-2000s, Street Fighter 4 was credited with reinvigorating the fighting game scene, following several years of the genre being overshadowed by new game IP on the rise.

articles.title: Wardogs Dev Explains Why Blue Team Loses More, Confirms Plan to Address the Balance in Season 2
articles.summary: The team behind Wardogs has confirmed that Lonestar, AKA the blue team, loses more than other team, and is making big changes in Season 2 to fix that. Since Wardogs launched in early September, there have been no shortage of memes mocking the game's blue team, Lonestar.
body: Speaking exclusively with IGN, Bulkhead confirmed that Lonestar's win percentage is lower than other teams in Wardogs, but it has actually increased over time. Lonestar's win rate was roughly 10% during the game's alpha, but has risen to 20% in recent weeks. Bulkhead co-founder Howard Philpott noted that this is partially a result of players choosing to support Lonestar because they see it as an underdog challenge. He even joked that blue team's reputation was a bit of a PR issue.

"So originally, and this is key to not misquote, it was like 10% in the alpha," he said. "So that then led to the perception: blue is bad, don't join blue. And then everyone tries to click on green and click on red because they're competitive and they want to win. So they're going on the better team. More recently, it's closer to 15 to 20%. It's probably closer to 20% right now, where people have actively been joining blue team to try and make them win, which is quite entertaining to watch. But it's undeniable, they are losing more than the other two teams because of that perception."
points: The team behind Wardogs has confirmed that Lonestar, AKA the blue team, loses more than other team, and is making big changes in Season 2 to fix that.

articles.title: Is GTA 6 Coming To Switch 2? Ask Rockstar, Nintendo Says
articles.summary: Rockstar's GTA 6 is the biggest game of 2026 and possibly ever, but it's not coming to Switch 2... or is it? Nintendo of America's new president, Devon Pritchard, was recently asked if GTA 6 is coming to Switch 2, and she didn't say yes or no.
body: “That’s going to be a conversation for Take-Two and Rockstar, but nothing to announce on my end at this time,” Pritchard told Variety.

In May of 2025, a report from NateTheHate said Rockstar was conducting tests to see about bringing GTA 6 to Switch 2. He clarified that this doesn't mean GTA 6 was planned for Switch 2, going on to say developers regularly conduct tests to see if their games are technically feasible on different platforms.
For now, GTA 6 is confirmed only for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S when it launches on November 19. History suggests that a PC edition will follow later, but this is not confirmed.

CEO Strauss Zelnick said the company could bring more games to Switch 2, but it's unknown if GTA 6 may be among them. He said Take-Two “would not necessarily bring every title to the platform,” but he noted there is a “great” opportunity to bring some of its older titles to Switch 2. He also said he is a “big believer” in the Switch 2.

articles.title: Is The BioShock Movie Ever Going To Happen? Director Weighs In
articles.summary: A movie adaptation of the popular game series BioShock has been in the works for a long time, and like a lot of film projects, it appears to be trapped in Development Hell. It remains to be seen how things will shake out with BioShock, but now its director has provided a positive-sounding update.
body: Francise Lawrence told GamesRadar that the team is "still working on a script," but he believes, "We're pretty close." He added: "I'm feeling really good about it."

Hollywood is littered with stories of filmmakers who are excited about projects, only to see them never materialize for countless reasons. That could happen for BioShock, too, but Lawrence is hopeful.
"Yeah, I would love to make it. I've been like dying to. I've been working at it. I've been trying," he said.

A BioShock movie has been in development for more than a decade now, with Pirates of the Caribbean director Gore Verbinski originally tapped to direct for a theatrical release. He pushed for a big-budget, R-rated version, and the studio reportedly balked after Zach Snyder's expensive Watchmen adaptation flopped.

articles.title: High Console Prices Push Playstation and Xbox Sales to New Lows
articles.summary: As an ongoing component crisis continues to drive up console prices, gaming hardware sales are tanking. According to new U.S. retail data from Circana, Xbox hardware sales were down 33% year-to-date in August compared to this point in 2025.
body: In August, PlayStation unit sales fell 11% year over year, bringing them to the lowest August total since 2013. Xbox sales declined even more aggressively, down 31% for the lowest August since 2020. Nintendo also took a hit, down 15% from August last year. This certainly isn’t the first time we’ve heard that console sales are down. Circana previously reported similarly grim data for July.

All three major console manufacturers have raised hardware prices over the last year and a half. Microsoft’s Xbox Series X and S have had multiple price increases, with the Xbox Series X now going for $799.99, which is $300 more than at launch. The base PS5 went from $499 to $549.99 in August 2025, before getting bumped another $100 in April 2026. The Nintendo Switch 2 received a $50 increase this past September.
points: As an ongoing component crisis continues to drive up console prices, gaming hardware sales are tanking.
According to new U.S. retail data from Circana, Xbox hardware sales were down 33% year-to-date in August compared to this point in 2025.

articles.title: Street Fighter Movie Officially Reveals Its Big Animated Twist
articles.summary: The creators of the new Street Fighter movie have been sitting on a secret: A surprising amount of the film is told through traditional 2D animation, one of the film's many throwbacks to the '90s.
body: For a movie that is steeped in '90s sights and sounds, the use of sequences inspired by Japanese animation to tell parts of Street Fighter's story makes sense. It's a way to avoid being "cheesy" during key emotional moments, according to Street Fighter director and co-writer Kitao Sakurai.

The new Street Fighter movie uses animation almost exclusively during flashbacks. These sequences touch on Ken and Ryu's training under their sensei, Master Gouken (played by Don Lee). Street Fighter actually opens with an animated sequence that recounts the first World Warrior tournament and the history of two great rivalries in Street Fighter lore.
Speaking with Sakurai, I asked why the filmmaker decided to insert 2D animation into the otherwise live-action production.

"When we were writing it, we knew that we needed to understand the sort of emotional backstories of Ken and Ryu and what led them to this place, because that's really the heart of the story," Sakurai explained. "Traditionally, if you're gonna do these flashback sequences, you need to make a choice whether to [either] de-age the actors or to hire child actors, and with the tone that we were going for, none of that felt right."
points: The creators of the new Street Fighter movie have been sitting on a secret: A surprising amount of the film is told through traditional 2D animation, one of the film's many throwbacks to the '90s.

articles.title: New D&D Baldur's Gate 3 Series Stars Everyone’s Favorite Vampire Spawn
articles.summary: Larian Studios’ smash hit RPG Baldur's Gate 3 is packed with rich characters, but the clear fan favorite is the vampire spawn rogue Astarion Ancunín. The sassy undead heartthrob already got a prequel novel written by Nettle & Bone author T.
body: The first six issues of Baldur’s Gate 3 will follow Astarion after he frees himself from the influence of his vampire master Cazador Szarr during the events of the game. New trouble is brewing in Waterdeep, and Astarion has to investigate a string of ritual murders before he becomes the killer’s next victim.

The story will be written by Alyssa Wong ( Deadpool ), penciled by Vincenzo Carratù ( Hulk: Smash Everything ), inked by Elisabetta D’Amico ( Avengers Assemble ), colored by Valentina Taddeo ( Werewolf by Night ), and lettered by Buddy Beaudoin ( The Flash ). There will be five variant covers including art from Gerald Parel, Scott Fischer, Angela Wu, and Tyler Walpole.

Baldur’s Gate 3 will continue with a 12-issue arc starring the tiefling barbarian Karlach as she travels through the Nine Hells. That story will be written by Becky Cloona ( Gotham Academy ) and illustrated by Francesco Scimonelli ( Dick Tracy ).

articles.title: I Really Want to Get Back into The Witcher 3 but I Have Save Game Anxiety
articles.summary: It can be quite a hump to get over. You're not in the flow anymore, and the flow can be hard to find. You could always start again, but that means losing all of your previous progress.
body: You know the feeling, I bet you do. There's a game you played and loved but never finished — or never felt you got closure on, in one way or another. And, suddenly, there's a compelling reason to go back, like a patch or visual refresh. But trying to start a big, complicated game in the middle is disorienting and hard work. You have to remember how everything works, what the buttons do, what's happening in the story, what all this stuff in your inventory does, how you set up your character build, where the useful vendors are, and so on.

I'm in this position right now with The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. I'd like to go back to the game to check out all the changes and improvements in the new, free Remastered update. I'd also like to be poised and ready, immersed in the character of Geralt and his world, by the time the new expansion Songs of the Past drops next year.

But in this case, my dilemma is more complicated than choosing between picking up old threads or starting again. I've played this game a lot — mostly a long time ago — and started new saves a bunch of times. I've got a bewildering variety of starting points to pick from.
points: You're not in the flow anymore, and the flow can be hard to find.
You could always start again, but that means losing all of your previous progress.
There's a game you played and loved but never finished — or never felt you got closure on, in one way or another.

articles.title: It's official: Forza Horizon 6 delayed to 2027 on PS5, and the game's first expansion has been announced
articles.summary: The reports were correct: Forza Horizon 6 has been delayed to 2027 on PS5. The PlayStation version had been expected this year - the PC and Xbox versions launched in May - but it will now launch in January.
body: Specifically, the PS5 version launches 26th January, Playground announced on the Forza website - with the option of early access from 21st January if you splash for a Premium Edition of the game, which costs an eye-watering £110.

21st January is also when the game's first paid expansion arrives, which will be included with the Premium Edition, thank god. There will also be a free update released that day for everyone else, though there's no further details about either release yet.

The PS5 version of Forza Horizon 6 is said to manage 30FPS at 4K in the game's Quality mode - visible in a pre-order trailer, apparently - and 60FPS in the game's Performance mode. And because cross-platform play and cross-saves are supported, you can play with other people on other platforms, and play on other platforms if you want. All user-made stuff like liveries and tuning setups are cross-platform too.

body: There's lots to look forward to and here, we'll break down everything you need to know about how and where to watch the show, and what to expect.

Hosted by fabulous friend of Eurogamer, Jane Douglas - who you'll probably know from Outside Xbox - the Galaxies Showcase airs 15th October at the very respectable hour of 8pm BST / 9pm CEST / 12pm PT / 3pm ET.

There's a long list of publishers showing their wares during the Galaxies Showcase, which include Square Enix Collective, PUBG maker Krafton, The Finals and Arc Raiders maker Embark Studios, as mentioned above. There will also be Focus Entertainment, the Phasmophobia studio's new publishing arm Kinetic Publishing, Team17, Saber Interactive, 4Dvinity, Raw Fury, Wired Productions, Frontier Development, ZA/UM and many more. We're promised "a spread of blockbuster franchises, anticipated sequels, and brand-new announcements" to be unveiled on the night.
None of the specific games appearing have been revealed, but our roundup of last year's Galaxies Showcase should give you a good idea of what to expect.

videos.summary: Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! On this week's episode, Daemon, Max, and Ryan look into Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's recent quotes taken from company town hall meeting. Xbox is trying to turn a corner in this current generation, while also preparing for next-gen and Project Helix. Can it be done?
body: Listen or watch on Spotify
points: On this week's episode, Daemon, Max, and Ryan look into Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's recent quotes taken from company town hall meeting.
Xbox is trying to turn a corner in this current generation, while also preparing for next-gen and Project Helix.
And is a "family of devices" for gen 10 a path of succcess for Xbox?
And finally, the Next-Gen Console Watch crew bids farewell to one of their own.
videos.author: IGN

videos.title: Battlefield REDSEC: Rapid Royale - Gameplay Trailer | PS5 Games
videos.summary: Battle Royale hits the fast lane 🔥
body: Rapid Royale comes to Battlefield #REDSEC with Season 5 on Oct. 13.

Drop into Las Vegas and fight across multiple maps with fewer players, smaller play spaces, faster-moving circles, and shorter matches. Loot weapons, get kills, and earn redeploys while high-value airdrops bring some of the best loot in the game.
Stay ahead of the fastest Ring of Fire and keep moving.
